name: Rome Fiumicino Leonardo da Vinci Airport

permits.v: ADR states the airport accepts general aviation (including company/executive travel and air taxi) subject to the limits in AIP AD 2; ADR's general-aviation category excludes scheduled, charter and cargo commercial transport.
permits.quote: General Aviation activities do not include scheduled, charter or cargo commercial transport.

notes: ENAV AIP Italia not opened (registration required; ADR's own page says the same). ADR pages read gave no runway, hours or customs figures. Only ADR's general-aviation acceptance text was found. Check AIP AD 2 LIRF and NOTAM before quoting.
